cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Could You Just…
cards.instruction: Turn a difficult task into tiny favors until the help quietly becomes most of the task.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Could you hold this shelf bracket against the holes? It keeps slipping.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Could you turn that top screw once? Then you can let go.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's holding. The other screws are already lined up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Just tighten those, then? And slide the shelf onto it to check. I'll get your coat.

mechanism: A uses precise shelf-installation corrections to enlarge a tiny holding favour until B performs the assembly while A stays the expert supervisor.
confusable: Ordinary instruction can help someone own a task; here it is A task and the requested minor help quietly becomes most of the labour.
comparison: Bouquet alternative grows through finishing and presentation, while shelf alternative uses support, fastening and fitting.
seedUse: Shelf bracket, work departure and aligned screws come from D25-a; S03 adds exact correction of level, torque and seating through the expanding favours.
